name: Sloppy Joes
description: Sloppy joes chock full of veggies and flavor. Probably a little too sloppy for Wellington. You can substitute other vegetables like spaghetti squash or zucchini.
directions: Brown meat in instant pot on saute mode, transfer to bowl.
Saute onions, peppers, and garlic in the fat from the meat.
Add rest of ingredients, do not stir to prevent burning.
Cover and cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.
